Privacy policy

cloudbackup is a personal backup tool. Its only user is its owner, GitHub user Joker691337.

  • It accesses only the owner's own Google Drive, with the owner's consent, to upload, verify and remove the owner's own backups.
  • It collects no data from anyone else.
  • Data stays on the owner's computer and in the owner's Google Drive; nothing is sold or shared with third parties.
  • No cookies, no analytics, no tracking.

Contact: github.com/Joker691337
